# Test vectors for mpt.Tree.Scan, mpt.ProvePrefix, and mpt.VerifyPrefix,
# generated by mkprefix.go.
#
# Each test is a run of zero or more kv lines followed by a snap line,
# building and snapshotting a tree, followed by zero or more
# prefix/hash/proof groups tested against that snapshot. The kv set is
# cleared after each snap line, so any kv lines that follow belong to
# the next test. Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored.
#
# Format:
#   kv HEXKEY HEXVAL   - add a key-value pair to the current tree
#   snap HEXHASH       - snapshot the tree; its hash must equal HEXHASH
#   prefix HEXPREFIX   - set the prefix under test
#   prefix ''          - set the prefix to empty (zero-length)
#   hash HEXHASH       - ProvePrefix(prefix) hash should equal HEXHASH
#   proof HEXPROOF     - ProvePrefix(prefix) proof, verified with VerifyPrefix
#
# For each prefix/hash/proof group, a conformance test should also
# collect the pairs among the tree's own kv lines whose key has the
# prefix (using HasPrefix), and check that: Scan(prefix) yields exactly
# that set, in key order; TreeHash of that set equals the recorded
# hash; and VerifyPrefix(snap, prefix, hash, proof) succeeds.
#
# Proof lines may be continued with \ at end of line;
# continuation lines conventionally start with a tab.
# The hex for kv, snap, prefix, hash, and proof may contain spaces.
#
# DO NOT EDIT. Generated by:
#   go run testdata/mkprefix.go > testdata/prefix.txt
